bibliographic.title: Tell Me Everything
bibliographic.author: Yuliia Vlaskova and Alien Anberlin
bibliographic.description:
TW: madness, mentions of death and suicide

No need for silence once you acquire whispers. Once they fill your head, you're free to tell all your secrets, relive your tales, regain your self. Seven words at a time, unlimited number of times.

Tell Me Everything is a text-based interactive experience developed as a submission for Dialogue Jam 2025. Set in the world of silence, this dialogue features a conversation between two characters, each with a story to tell. The player decides what their story is, leading to nine endings across three distinct routs.

One walkthrough takes around 10-15 minutes. Enjoy!

Co-authored by Yuliia Vlaskova and Alien Anberlin.
